scenes.label: Meet Rohan
scenes.title: A robot that dances!
scenes.caption: Meet Rohan. His new dancing robot, Tiko, arrived today! Tiko spins, flashes its lights and says, "Let's dance!" Rohan dances with it all afternoon. He thinks Tiko is his new best friend.
scenes.dialogue: Tiko, you’re the best dancer ever!

scenes.label: Bedtime surprise
scenes.title: “I’m hungry!” at bedtime
scenes.caption: At bedtime, Tiko's lights blink. "I'm hungry!" it says. Rohan gasps. Is Tiko sad and lonely? He holds a biscuit up to Tiko's face. Crumbs fall everywhere. But Tiko just says the same words again.
scenes.dialogue: Oh no! Is Tiko sad and lonely?

scenes.label: Ask Nani
scenes.title: Nani reads Tiko’s rules.
scenes.caption: Rohan runs to Nani. She smiles. "What a kind heart you have." Then she reads Tiko's instruction card. When the battery is low, say, I'm hungry. People wrote that rule! Tiko needs charging, not biscuits.

scenes.label: Sort it out
scenes.title: Alive or machine?
scenes.caption: Next morning, Moti, the neighbour's puppy, visits. Nani makes up a game. Help Rohan sort five things into Alive or Machine. Moving and talking aren't enough. Ask: does it grow and need care? Or follow a program?

scenes.label: What’s alive?
scenes.title: It can say it. It can’t feel it.
scenes.caption: Nani explains. Living things, like Moti and the plant, grow and need care. Moti needs food. The plant needs water and sunlight. Machines, like Tiko, follow a program, the instructions people write. Tiko can say I'm hungry, but it can't feel hungry.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Charged up and dancing!
scenes.caption: Tiko's battery is full now. It spins and says, "Let's dance!" Moti wags his tail. Rohan still loves his robot. A robot can talk and dance, but it isn't alive. Your turn: help Rohan sort more things!
